# Canvas Runner Idea

A side‑scrolling endless runner on an HTML canvas. The player controls a character that automatically moves forward; using tap/space they can jump to avoid randomly generated obstacles (spikes, gaps, moving blocks). The game ends (lose condition) when the character collides with an obstacle or falls off the bottom of the canvas.

**Key Features**
- Simple controls (single key/tap for jump).
- Procedurally generated obstacle patterns.
- Score based on distance traveled.
- Simple graphics drawn with canvas shapes.

1: // Simple endless runner targeting canvas with id="game"
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: 
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
7: 
8: // Game config
9: function playTone(freq, duration) {
10:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
13:   osc.type = 'sine';
14:   osc.connect(gain);
15:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:   osc.start();
18:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19: }
20: const GRAVITY = 0.6;
21: const JUMP = -12;
22: const PLAYER_W = 30;
23: const PLAYER_H = 50;
24: const OBSTACLE_W = 30;
25: const OBSTACLE_GAP = 200; // distance between obstacles
26: const SPEED = 4;
27: const GROUND_HEIGHT = 40;
28: 
29: let player = {x: 50, y: canvas.height - PLAYER_H - GROUND_HEIGHT, w: PLAYER_W, h: PLAYER_H, vy: 0, onGround: true};
30: let obstacles = [];
31: let frames = 0;
32: let score = 0;
33: let gameOver = false;
34: 
35: function spawnObstacle() {
36:   const height = Math.random() * (PLAYER_H * 2) + 20; // variable height
37:   obstacles.push({x: canvas.width, y: canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT - height, w: OBSTACLE_W, h: height});
38: }
39: 
40: function reset() {
41:   player.y = canvas.height - PLAYER_H - GROUND_HEIGHT; player.vy = 0; player.onGround = true;
42:   obstacles = [];
43:   frames = 0; score = 0; gameOver = false;
44: }
45: 
46: function update() {
47:   if (gameOver) return;
48:   frames++;
49:   // player physics
50:   player.vy += GRAVITY;
51:   player.y += player.vy;
52:   if (player.y + player.h >= canvas.height - GROUND_HEIGHT) {
53:     player.y = canvas.height - player.h;
54:     player.vy = 0;
55:     player.onGround = true;
56:   } else {
57:     player.onGround = false;
58:   }
59:   // obstacles movement
60:   obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SPEED);
61:   // remove off‑screen obstacles
62:   obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.w > 0);
63:   // spawn new obstacles periodically
64:   if (frames % Math.round(OBSTACLE_GAP / SPEED) === 0) spawnObstacle();
65:   // collision detection
66:   for (let o of obstacles) {
67: if (player.x < o.x + o.w && player.x + player.w > o.x &&
68:         player.y < o.y + o.h && player.y + player.h > o.y) {
69:       gameOver = true;
70:       playTone(220, 0.3); // collision sound
71:       break;
72:     }
73:   if (!gameOver) score = Math.floor(frames / 5);
74: }
75: 
76: function draw() {
77:   // background gradient sky
78:   const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
79:   bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // sky blue
80:   bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#B0E0E6'); // light steel blue
81:   ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
82:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
83: 
84:   // ground rectangle
85:   const groundHeight = 40;
86:   ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
87:   ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - groundHeight, canvas.width, groundHeight);
88: 
89:   // obstacles with gradient fill
90:   const obsGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
91:   obsGrad.addColorStop(0, '#FF6F61');
92:   obsGrad.addColorStop(1, '#FF3B30');
93:   ctx.fillStyle = obsGrad;
94:   obstacles.forEach(o => {
95:     ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
96:   });
97: 
98:   // player - rounded rectangle with gradient
99:   const playerGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, player.y, 0, player.y + player.h);
100:   playerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4A90E2');
101:   playerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0A84FF');
102:   ctx.fillStyle = playerGrad;
103:   ctx.beginPath();
104:   const r = 5; // corner radius
105:   ctx.moveTo(player.x + r, player.y);
106:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w - r, player.y);
107:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y, player.x + player.w, player.y + r);
108:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h - r);
109:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x + player.w, player.y + player.h, player.x + player.w - r, player.y + player.h);
110:   ctx.lineTo(player.x + r, player.y + player.h);
111:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y + player.h, player.x, player.y + player.h - r);
112:   ctx.lineTo(player.x, player.y + r);
113:   ctx.quadraticCurveTo(player.x, player.y, player.x + r, player.y);
114:   ctx.closePath();
115:   ctx.fill();
116: 
117:   // score text
118:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
119:   ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
120:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
121: 
122:   // game over overlay
123:   if (gameOver) {
124:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
125:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
126:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
127:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
128:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
129:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
130:   }
131: }
132: }
133: 
134: function loop() {
135:   update();
136:   draw();
137:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
138: }
139: 
140: // input handling
141: function jump() {
142:   if (player.onGround && !gameOver) {
143:     player.vy = JUMP;
144:     player.onGround = false;
145:     playTone(440, 0.1); // jump sound
146:   } else if (gameOver) {
147:     reset();
148:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
149:   }
150: }
151: 
152: document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') jump(); });
153: document.addEventListener('touchstart', jump);
154: 
155: // start game
156: requestAnimationFrame(loop);

(End of file - total 156 lines)
</content>
